scope: Counts value-bound scalar ring operations for inverse and rectangular multiplication under explicit modular-operation and extended-GCD bit-cost hypotheses. Excludes memory allocation/indexing, external-tree integration, curve coverage, and end-to-end ECDLP expected time.
statement: The complete executable planted-kernel construction, including Bird inverse, dense rectangular postprocessing, and output negation, has an explicit conditional polynomial bit-work bound.
